purpose: Illustrative photos for the homepage process section
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Make a premium editorial photograph for the How it works section of Reviyo, an Indian local business review tool. Landscape 4:3 composition, close-up, authentic small Indian cafe, warm walnut counter, pale mint ceramic cups, soft natural window light, navy and muted sage accents. Human hands anatomically correct. The final crop will be 4:3. No floating graphics, no icons, no star ratings, no testimonials, no watermark, no 3D render. It must look like a real understated product-in-use photograph, with sharp main subject and softly blurred real cafe background. STEP 1, SCAN: close view of an adult Indian customer's hand holding a smartphone upright, camera directed toward a beautiful small white tabletop QR display on the cafe counter. The display has one crisp dark navy QR pattern, a small simple heading 'How was your visit?' above it, a tiny 'Reviyo' wordmark below. The phone shows a realistic camera view of the QR card. The composition clearly communicates scanning a counter QR. The counter card is the main focal subject, phone to right, mint cup in background. No review text. Not a portrait; hands and objects only.
